fields.label: Slug
fields.description: Stable key used in cache keys and routing labels. Lowercase; cannot be changed casually.

fields.label: SIP domain
fields.description: The FreeSWITCH domain for this Tenant. Leave blank to use only the context mapping.

fields.label: Default context
fields.description: The FreeSWITCH context for this Tenant. Must be unique among enabled Tenants.

fields.label: Main inbound number
fields.description: Optional fallback inbound number for a DID without an assigned Flow. Transfers to this number in the Tenant context.

fields.label: Outbound caller ID
fields.description: Fallback caller ID for extensions in this Tenant when the extension has no explicit number.

fields.label: Music on hold
fields.description: Overrides the global hold music for this Tenant's queues.

fields.label: Members
fields.description: Users who may access this Tenant. Admin manages config; Supervisor runs live operations; Agent sees their own extension.
